@name: Cultist
@slug: cultist
@source: channeling_companion
@category: RMFRP Channeling Companion
@default_cost: 52
@description:
 [Lifestyle] A cultist studies the ways of summoning and conjuring. They can
 be either the leader of a strange cult, a follower of such a cult, or a
 character with extensive knowledge of such cults sent to destroy them. In all
 cases, they are experts on finding signs of the supernatural and
 extra-planar, and how to deal with the creatures that are summoned from other
 planes. Quote: You cannot cross the wards placed about the circle and you
 will answer the questions I ask before I allow you to return to your own
 plane. Time to Acquire: 129 months. Starting Money: normal + d10 (open
 ended).
